Aero 1.2.65: every tuning setting can be pinned per model, and profiles are one click away.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.2.65_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.2.65_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.2.65-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.2.65-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## What's new

- **Tuning settings.** Open them from the tuning dialog, or from a model's ⋯ menu → *Tuning settings…*. Each setting stays *Automatic* or is pinned:
  - context;
  - KV cache, with keys and values set separately (e.g. K q8_0 + V q4_0);
  - layers on the CPU and how they split;
  - flash attention, batch sizes and threads;
  - memory mapping and locking;
  - longer context with YaRN.

  The tuner keeps your pins and searches the rest.
- **Smarter KV search.** The tuner can now also try keys at q8_0 with values at q4_0. It saves memory while keeping the more sensitive half precise.
- **Profiles one click away.** Use a model's ⋯ menu → *Profile…* to switch between the setups Aero measured: Maximum Speed, Balanced, Maximum Context, Maximum Quality, Agent Optimized or Efficiency. No re-tune needed.
- Version numbers now go 1.2.6 → 1.2.65 → 1.2.70, so every updater keeps them in order.

Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
